## Discussion (1)

### rodaddy — 2026-08-08T22:17:34Z

Fixed by PR #657 (merged 120ad41) and independently verified against the live dogfood service before merge: verify-lane receipt bound to 3f21578, done-means scripts/done-means/654-namespace-scope-proof.sh exit 0, all five clauses — capture durable in the requested namespace (lane_namespace matched the throwaway e2e654 namespace, read from the database), weak-token delegation refused with nothing written, refusal names the cause (403 'Role not permitted to delegate namespace'), and the default path stays healthy (lane_namespace=rico). Root cause was client-side: runtime.py hardcoded delegate_namespace=False since #294, so X-Namespace was never sent and delegated-intent sessions silently landed in namespace 'admin'. Fix adds OPENBRAIN_DELEGATE_NAMESPACE (required-explicit, default OFF); no server redeploy needed (lane's claim, consistent with the live verify passing against the unmodified service). Downstream-rollout: additive opt-in, Hermes canary becomes required at first flag-on deployment (recorded on the PR). Lessons harvested: lane-contract round 15 (d84206e).
